rationale: Russian strikes on Kyiv continue the war pattern affecting Black Sea neighbor Ukraine; Hungary's diplomatic shift is a new regional development.

top_events.title: At least two people dead after Russian strikes on Kyiv
top_events.label: Russian strikes kill two in Kyiv
top_events.summary: Russian drone strikes on Ukraine's capital killed at least two people. The ongoing war continues to affect Romania's Black Sea neighbor and regional security.

top_events.title: Hungary expels 10 Russian diplomats as relations worsen
top_events.label: Hungary expels ten Russian diplomats
top_events.summary: Hungary's new government abandons its pro-Kremlin stance and expels Russian diplomats, marking a shift in regional EU-Russia relations near Romania.

top_events.title: Saudi Arabia vows to respond after Houthis attack cities and energy facilities
top_events.label: Houthi attacks injure 73 in Saudi Arabia
top_events.summary: Iran-backed Houthi attacks on Saudi cities and oil facilities injured 73 people. The escalation adds to Middle East tensions affecting global energy markets.

short_summary: AfD wins 44% in German state election

most_significant_event.label: AfD wins 44% in German state election
most_significant_event.summary: Far-right party projected to win Saxony-Anhalt with 44%, far ahead of conservatives. First far-right state government in Germany since WWII shifts EU political dynamics.
